Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) downgraded to OUT vs Commanders.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring +7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson absence opens targets; soft secondary.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: Fade PHI pass catchers/QB; boost opposing.
items.opportunity: Snap share to remaining skill players.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles B2B, hurt (chest), Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. Passes eye test long-term though.
LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ yds to RB every game.
LOVE Drake London @ NO (35%+ TS with Penix, 9-194 last); LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI (36% TS no Mitchell, efficiency high). Also LOVE Josh Downs, George Kittle; parlay lean Addison/Wilson.
items.opportunity: Target share expansion (Wilson no Mitchell; Addison no JJ).

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: low util (3.5% TS, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3, 13% 3rd down); SEA allows 2.9 YPC. Also HATE Herbert, Pitts, Egbuka, Worthy.
